  "overall_experience": "This Artist Relations Manager found Canva to be an excellent tool for quickly generating visually appealing promotional materials and artist-related content using its vast template library. Its ease of use allowed them to produce professional designs without needing extensive graphic design skills, significantly streamlining their workflow.
